note: Human adjudications of MIW topic mappings. This file is HAND-MAINTAINED and is an INPUT to build_study_mappings.py -- never edit docs/study/study_mappings.json directly. Three decisions are available. AFFIRM (the default) promotes one mapping to VALID_MAPPED by supplying the review stamp the validator demands. REASSIGN moves a question the mapper placed wrongly, and must also carry mapper_topic_id. HOLD_REVIEW records that a human read the question and found the evidence did not settle it: the mapping is forced to REVIEW_PENDING with candidate_topic_ids, and is never published. In every case the mapper's own current topic must be RESTATED (mapper_topic_id, defaulting to topic_id) so a taxonomy change that moves the question is caught rather than silently rubber-stamped.

QB1_A#q13.note: London Convention/Protocol governs prevention of marine pollution by DUMPING of wastes at sea. It is a pollution-prevention instrument, not a liability or insurance one. The file title 'Conventions & Liability Law' captured it on the word 'Convention' alone.

The applied half is thermal runaway, CO2 ineffectiveness and the SOLAS II-2 amendments under MSC.520(106), which is D08. Which limb an examiner pursues is not knowable from the stem. Held rather than forced.
